title: Cuelor Provider API v1: shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the other v1 schemas. Objects allow unknown members: receivers MUST ignore fields they do not recognise.

code.description: Error category. Descriptive: services MAY use codes not listed in the specification; clients handle unknown codes by HTTP status.

message.description: English, human readable. MUST NOT contain secrets, full upstream URLs or signed parameters. SHOULD be at most 300 characters.

params.description: Structured details for the reason, for example `{"role": "video_track", "max": 3, "received": 4}`.

media_type.description: A MIME type without parameters, for example `image/png`.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 hexadecimal digits. Services SHOULD use lowercase; clients compare case-insensitively.

binding.description: Stable fingerprint of the upstream account or credentials: 64 hexadecimal digits. MUST change when the account changes, and when the key changes unless the service still finds its jobs and idempotency records under the new key (v1.md section 3.2).

idempotency_key.description: Value of the `Idempotency-Key` header: 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters (0x21-0x7E).

prompt_reference.description: A reference to an ordered input inside a prompt. In running text a reference is `@(image|video|audio)[1-9][0-9]*` not immediately followed by another digit; any other `@` is plain text.

unit.description: `credits` (the official service) or an ISO 4217 currency code.

language_tag.description: BCP 47 language tag, for example `en` or `zh`.

basis.description: `billed`: what the upstream or the official service actually charged. `estimate`: the service's own calculation.

artifact_metadata.description: Optional media metadata. Images: `width`, `height`. Video: also `duration_ms`, `audio`. Audio: `duration_ms`, `sample_rate`.
